searchText: Ser the wallet i used for this POAP has been compromised, on the claim page also there is a section where we can choose what address our poap go to but we cant enter a new wallet address. could you please talk to POAP team or your own core team members to provide us a way to be able to claim our poaps in a new safe wallet? when we connect our eligible wallet it means we are the true owners so no need to worry about anything <@420951281910284289> Verify done but still not eligible My GitHub contribution <@420951281910284289> any solution sir for GitHub contributors???? Sir how just tell me steps?? well not yet <@485849969568514048> no, there is no POAP if you contributed with github Plz ask the team to consider for people who have done theough github.. it would make us happy.. i am on the team. unfortunately i don't think it's likely that we try to add this feature at this point for this project. it would be on the POAP team to decide whether they want to support this, but i don't know whether they will one way or the other Ok.. plz consider us .. it ll b vry glad if u take this matter into conisderation... becoz it would b helpful for us in future benefits .ty in advance.. wish u and ur team gud luck Ser I need a help please <@420951281910284289> <nicoserranop> It is worth pointing out that the GitHub and eth addresses are embedded in the ceremony transcript for all eternity. This POAP is only a commemorative item but your GitHub contribution will stay on the transcript and you can show people you participated in it by showing your username in the transcript for anyone with questions related to claiming the KZG Ceremony POAP with a GitHub credential: the Ceremony contribution interface was clear that the only way POAPs could be claimed was if contributors signed in with an Ethereum address. The POAP Checkout feature only supports Ethereum address whitelists. We have passed along all of this feedback to the POAP team, but ultimately it's up to them whether they would like to support a Github claim process. I have no expectations whether they will or not. please see the channel's pinned message ser i dont need that github thing, i am eligible with my compromised address and now i need to claim with the new metamask wallet i created and we have this feature in the claim page but it does not allow to enter our desired address. this is the problem <@420951281910284289> Ty for taking effort and passing to poap team.. I believe the POAP Checkout product you have to be able to sign a tx with the Private Key associated with the eligible address. if you're saying you want to sign with the compromised address but send the POAP to a different address - i don't think they support this what about claiming and transfering it to a new wallet, how about that? any tool? <@420951281910284289> please there's no guarantee whoever has access to the account won't transfer it out first. have other NFTs in the account been transferred/sold? well no ser. can team do me a favour and remove my compromised wallet from the list and replace it with my fresh wallet? the transcript is final, we can't change it so what solution team offers for such cases? i mean teams usually consider supporting when people face such unexpected issues. <nicoserranop> > <nicoserranop> Be careful with your wallet in the future 😊 (re @kzg_ceremony_bot: <road.bnb> [reply]: so what solution team offers for such cases? i mean teams usually consider supporting when people face such unexpected issues.) well hacks happens exactly when you DONT see it right? so you're sure you are in a right place but after months it turns out to be a scam link. isn't it? and why you dont reply with your own accounts here ser? people think its a bot or an AI talking to them, last night a dude was cursing this bot in a reply. this is so confusing to us. i would help if i could, unfortunately the only extent in this case is to offer my time to understand your problem and think through solutions. the Ceremony produced a final output. any change to it breaks the collective social consensus that this is the legitimate output, so it cannot be changed the list of addresses which contributed to the Ceremony output was passed to the POAP team. even if it were possible for the POAP team to swap in your new address in place of the old one for the whitelist, it would be strange in the future to see an address which did not contribute to the Ceremony claim the POAP. for this reason, i don't think it makes sense to pursue i'm sorry your wallet was compromised, that's a tough thing to deal with if there is still ETH in the account, you may be able to claim to the address and move to a fresh address if someone is running a sweeper bot that claims any ETH you send there, i'm afraid it will be much harder to do. possibly through a private relay but i don't know if the things held at your wallet warrant that much effort

i would help if i could, unfortunately the only extent in this case is to offer my time to understand your problem and think through solutions. 

the Ceremony produced a final output. any change to it breaks the collective social consensus that this is the legitimate output, so it cannot be changed

the list of addresses which contributed to the Ceremony output was passed to the POAP team. even if it were possible for the POAP team to swap in your new address in place of the old one for the whitelist, it would be strange in the future to see an address which did not contribute to the Ceremony claim the POAP. for this reason, i don't think it makes sense to pursue

i'm sorry your wallet was compromised, that's a tough thing to deal with

if someone is running a sweeper bot that claims any ETH you send there, i'm afraid it will be much harder to do. possibly through a private relay but i don't know if the things held at your wallet warrant that much effort
